title: Platinum Reserve Account: Eligibility Requirements for Enterprises
summary: This document outlines eligibility requirements for opening and maintaining a Platinum Reserve Account for enterprises, including a $100,000 minimum balance and a $250,000 minimum daily balance to waive the monthly maintenance fee. It also covers organizational readiness, required corporate documentation/authorized signer details, liquidity oversight internal controls, and ongoing monitoring/forecasting to avoid falling below thresholds.
faqs: What minimum balance is required to open and maintain a Platinum Reserve Account?
